sealed_zero_notes.note: two independent readings agree: a bare seal probe right after vent read +0.04, the four-state probe read -0.01. The sensor wire was not touched today.

zero_arc_note: the zero held between -0.95 and +0.04 all morning with raw p2p 3, which is the same band as D3's post-repair value. It moved +1.0 mmHg over nine minutes without any touch, so the D3 loose-wire diagnosis has not recurred; the difference between the open-check value and the probe value is within the day-to-day scatter seen on D1/D2.

valve_width_detail.note: the two widths now agree (0.31667 vs 0.31094), unlike D3 where the 4 ms probe read 0.32 against a 0.30063 blended answer. The series 0.24713 / 0.26805 / 0.30063 / 0.31381 keeps climbing but the increments are shrinking.

switching_note: the OmniProbe desktop app was not running at open; COM6 was reachable directly, so the first state check ran on the direct bridge. The app was started before the seal probe and every later command went through 127.0.0.1:8765, confirmed by the BRIDGE line.
